releasePolicy.platform: The platform may deploy only after its tests pass against this exact contract file.
releasePolicy.mlServices: ML services may deploy independently only when their OpenAPI contract remains byte-for-byte compatible or the platform manifest is updated in a reviewed pull request.
releasePolicy.rollback: Rollback either repository to the previously approved commit while retaining the same supported contract version.
releasePolicy.contractHash: SHA-256 of the contract with newlines normalised to LF and surrounding whitespace trimmed. Both repositories pin this value, so CI enforces the cross-repository lock without checking out the sibling repository and without CRLF/LF false failures.
